swmm_verification.units: SI: m, m3/s, seconds since model start
limitations: A 1% continuity check is a diagnostic, not field validation.
Flood CSV is an instantaneous-rate series; resampling must conserve its integrated volume.
No dynamic bidirectional coupling with the surface solver.
Review warnings, instability, geometry, datum and hydrological inputs in network.rpt.
No new calibrated city flood model. Existing 76 rain runs unchanged.
River selection uses nearest outlet distance only. It does not identify the main river or upstream boundary.
Do not treat GEOGLOWS forecasts as observed discharge or transfer one port tide to all coastal cities.
Resource year/name must be checked against dates inside the file.
Tides are predictions in MLWS; no conversion to terrain datum asserted.
GEOGLOWS discharge is modeled, not gauge observation.
Nearest river outlets are candidates, not verified inlet locations.
